sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 4 (#3) and Internal Quality Checks row 4 (#3); Deterministic Checks rows check-instruction-content.py, check-instruction-hygiene.py
evidence: Read instruction.md (9 lines, 259 words) and all three /instructions notes in full. Mechanical scans: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|TBD|lorem|<placeholder-tags>|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/ found no hits except the product word 'placeholder' in conversations.md:9 and walls-and-retention.md:35 (deleted-message placeholder, a genuine requirement, not a template marker). `file` reports all four files as pure ASCII with LF endings; no trailing whitespace, tabs or doubled words. Manual review of the full sorted unique-word list (about 600 words) found no misspellings (proper nouns Kittle, Rowe, Anand, Lloyd, Pryce, Marsh are seed names). Only paths are product paths (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions, /api/health), all matching the Dockerfile COPY and seed locations; no other machine's paths. No grader vocabulary (judge/rubric/criteri/reward/score/playwright/claude/glm/sentinel) present. The template's 'CHANGE_ME' instruction line is fully replaced. No duplicated paragraphs. Contradiction cross-check: one clock value (integration.md:7 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z = seed clock), one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11 = seed accounts and roles), one seed path, password123 once, timer options off/1/7/30 (walls-and-retention.md:23 = seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30]), Dev walled from M-12 (walls-and-retention.md:15 = seed M-12 walled ['dev@kittle.test']); delete-vs-hold statements agree (conversations.md:9 vs walls-and-retention.md:29); sign-in-only exposure agrees between instruction.md:7 and integration.md:9. The seed's 'Landlords notice recieved.' (K-2 earlier version) is deliberate seed content showing an edited typo, not instruction contamination. Broken/conforming alternatives: no wording here creates a misreading that would let a broken app pass or fail a conforming one for this row; minor DB_PATH phrasing ('when that is set' while launch always sets it) is consistent, not contradictory. This row is source-only; no runtime evidence is required.
